blocks.text: "I will start investing when I earn more." — The most expensive lie.

items: Start at 25: You invest ₹18 Lakhs -> You get ₹1.7 Crores.
Start at 35: You invest ₹12 Lakhs -> You get ₹48 Lakhs.

summary: Starting a SIP at 25 vs 35 isn't a 10-year gap — it's a ₹1.2 crore one. The real cost of waiting, in numbers.
title: SIP Power
